policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 26 Jun close (1x4 3.82, 3x6 3.81, 6x9 3.82, 9x12 3.85 vs WIBOR 3M 3.86) price no net NBP move within 12 months. The MPC held at 3.75% on 2 Jun (May CPI eased mainly on food; decisions stay data-dependent); Glapiński (3 Jun): lower May CPI cuts the hike odds, rates are high enough and there is no reason to change or even discuss them. Duda (18 Jun): stable rates the base case, little room for cuts; the May voting record (18 Jun) shows Tyrowicz's +100bp motion rejected again. May CPI 3.1% (final, 15 Jun; flash 29 May, 3.7% expected); core 3.1% (16 Jun). Standard fuel excise is back from 15 Jun; VAT 8% and price caps run to 30 June, with a VAT decision due 'shortly' (Tusk, 16 Jun).
policy.risk_text: US strikes on Iran (26-27 Jun), then a halt with Doha talks planned, show the MoU is fragile; FRAs price no NBP move; risks: oil, the fuel package ending in July, the July projection, and Q3 supply (plan due at end-June).

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026; IMF (14 Apr): 2026 CPI 3.3%; EC (21 May): GDP 3.5% in 2026; OECD (June outlook): CPI 3.7% in 2026, no cuts before Q2 2027; Fitch (8 Jun): GDP 3.3%, NBP flat at 3.75% to year-end; World Bank (11 Jun): GDP 3.1% / 2.6%; NBP survey of economists (24 Jun): CPI 3.0% / 2.9% (2026-27). The July projection is the next marker.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit 7.3% of GDP (GUS EDP, 22 Apr), debt 59.7%; 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; budget deficit after May PLN 108.2bn (~40% of the limit, 15 Jun); the government's assumptions put the 2026 deficit at ~6.8% of GDP; EC (21 May): 6.5%, debt 64.5%; EKF consensus (2 Jun): 6.9%; EDP debt 61.6% of GDP at end-Q1 (10 Jun); 2027 budget path (9 Jun): GDP 3.1%, CPI 2.5%; the Senate amended the windfall tax (25 Jun); fuel package (VAT 8%, price caps) to 30 June, standard excise back from 15 June.
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~62% (MoF, 24 Jun) financed; budget accounts PLN 208.3bn at end-May (MoF, 8 Jun); 3 Jun switch (MoF database): PLN 11.63bn sold (demand 12.84bn) vs 10.90bn bought back (PS0527 7.42bn), net +0.73bn; OK0129 4.812%, PS0731 5.269%, DS0436 5.703%; BGK priced EUR 2bn of FPC bonds (2 Jun). S&P A-/stable (8 May); Scope A negative (15 May); Fitch A- negative - its CEO (23 Jun, reported 24 Jun) calls public finances the main rating risk; Moody's A2 negative.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP held at 3.75% on 2 Jun; May CPI 3.1% y/y; Q1 GDP 3.5% y/y (second estimate). Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable. 26-28 Jun: GPWB 30 Jun change: OK0129 joins TBSP, 1-3Y, 1-4Y and 1-5Y; OK0127 leaves TBSP. Units rise for DS1033/DS1035/DS1034/DS1030/PS0731/DS0436, PS0527 falls (switch); 1-3Y now 6 bonds, TBSP 19. MoF: May EU funds EUR 1.13bn. Erste: 2027 FRAs within 7bp of spot. PKO: yields >30bp below end-May. SPW kept falling: 10Y ~5.30% (ING), DS0436 5.27%. e-petrol: pump prices rise after June. Abroad: Brent hit ~$72 (lowest since 27 Feb) before US strikes on Iranian missile sites (26-27 Jun) after a drone attack on a ship; Iran fired at bases in Kuwait and Bahrain, then on Sunday both sides agreed to halt attacks and meet in Doha on Tuesday. Trump threatened 100% tariffs on countries with digital taxes. FedWatch 42% for one hike, 28% for two; UST10 4.37%, Bund 2.85%; EZ consumer inflation expectations eased to 3.5%.

calendar.plan_text: MoF June plan (29 May): one switch on 3 Jun (settles 8 Jun; buys back DS0726, PS1026, WZ1126, OK0127, PS0527) and sale auctions on 17 and 24 Jun (PLN 6-12bn each) in OK0129, NZ0331, PS0731, DS0436 and NZ0936; no T-bills; ~56% of 2026 needs financed. 3 Jun switch (MoF database): PLN 11.63bn sold (demand 12.84bn) vs 10.90bn bought back (PS0527 7.42bn), net +0.73bn; OK0129 4.812%, PS0731 5.269%, DS0436 5.703%. 17 Jun sale: PLN 12.00bn vs 18.27bn demand (cover 1.52) plus 0.79bn; OK0129 4.399%, PS0731 4.918%, DS1030 4.711%, DS0436 5.416%. 24 Jun sale: PLN 12.00bn vs 15.42bn demand (cover 1.28) plus 1.32bn; OK0129 4.396%, PS0731 4.911%, DS1035 5.334%, DS0436 5.417%. BGK switch (18 Jun): PLN 1.35bn of FPC sold (demand 2.11bn) vs 1.44bn of FPC0427 bought back.
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; March's sell-off broke it and April's auction days cheapened on average. June supply is done (PLN 24.0bn sold in two sales plus 2.11bn additional, and the 3 Jun switch); the July/Q3 plan is due at end-June. Next MPC in July, with the NBP projection: a hold is expected. Covers: 1.52 (17 Jun), 1.28 (24 Jun) vs 1.25-1.33 in May.

core_text: Regime: oil back to pre-war levels (~$73) as Hormuz traffic normalises; the NBP held at 3.75% on 2 Jun while FRAs price no net NBP move; the ECB hiked to 2.25% on 11 Jun with one more hike priced, the Fed signals a 2026 hike in its dots, the BoE held 7-2, the CNB hiked to 3.75% and the MNB cut to 6.00%. Poland's 5Y CDS was 50bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 244bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 26 Jun close). US strikes Iran, then truce; Brent $72 (26-28 Jun).
